title: Extract transcript resize and deferred bottom-restore policy
outcome: The current scroll hardening adds pure resize-baseline policy to the oversized SessionPaneView.scroll.ts module and dedicated deferred-bottom timer plumbing to the oversized VirtualizedConversationMessageList.tsx component. Extract the pure resize policy into a focused SessionPaneView sibling module and encapsulate deferred bottom-restore scheduling/clearing beside the page-height and scroll-event coordination, preserving the explicit authority and cooldown invariants.
acceptance: The pure resize-baseline policy lives in ui/src/SessionPaneView.resize-measurement.ts with its own unit tests, and SessionPaneView's scroll code consumes it.

Deferred bottom-restore scheduling and clearing are owned by ui/src/panels/virtualized-conversation-deferred-bottom-restore.ts with its own tests; the hook exposes only clear, isPending and scheduleLayoutVersion, never its mutable ref.
VirtualizedConversationMessageList consumes that hook instead of its own timer plumbing.

completion.summary: Verification-only closure. The resize-baseline policy and deferred bottom-restore ownership were extracted by 27691245 (an ancestor of master 1495e8d3). SessionPaneView.resize-measurement.ts and its tests are consumed by SessionPaneView.scroll.ts. The virtualized-conversation-deferred-bottom-restore hook, with its tests, exposes only clear, isPending and scheduleLayoutVersion (the Beads review note is resolved) and is consumed by VirtualizedConversationMessageList. Independent evaluation ac7e7b21 passed 3/3.
